commentary.text: 90+9' That's it for today, Miguel Ortiz has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Ath Bilbao.
90+6' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Renzo Saravia trots off the pitch and is replaced by Jesus Vazquez (Valencia).

90+5' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) is challenged in the air near the penalty spot and is unable to control his header from the corner, sending it miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
90+4' The ball goes out for a corner. Ath Bilbao can continue in their attacking effort.
90+2' Valencia take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+2' Stole Dimitrievski pulls off a brilliant save! Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) launched himself and met a cross into the box, but his header to the right post is saved.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
88' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Miguel Ortiz had an easy-decision to make.
87' Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
85' Stole Dimitrievski (Valencia) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
83' Ath Bilbao fail to score from a corner as Stole Dimitrievski (Valencia) leaps to collect the ball.
83' The substitution is prepared. Unai Nunez (Valencia) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Javi Guerra.

78' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Ath Bilbao.

75' Stole Dimitrievski pulls off a fantastic save! Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the left post, but the effort is kept out.
72' 0 - 1 Goal! Luis Rioja picks out Umar Sadiq (Valencia) in the box with a decent cross, and he scores in the right side of the goal with a header from close range. 0:1.
71' We are about to witness a substitution. Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) is replacing Robert Navarro.

70' Here is a change. Diego Lopez is going off and Carlos Corberan gives the last tactical orders to Largie Ramazani (Valencia).
69' Ath Bilbao take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
68' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Ath Bilbao will take a corner kick.
65' Oihan Sancet goes off the pitch and Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) comes on.
64' Wonderful movement by Valencia. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
60' Ath Bilbao can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

60' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Stole Dimitrievski anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save. Ath Bilbao force a corner. They send men into the box.

54' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
52' Ath Bilbao take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
51' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Ath Bilbao.

51' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Ath Bilbao, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes behind for a corner. Ath Bilbao will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
50' Eray Comert (Valencia) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt. Ath Bilbao have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
46' Ernesto Valverde has decided to make a change. Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) replaces Aymeric Laporte.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Miguel Ortiz has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.

43' The referee blows his whistle, Valencia are awarded a corner kick.
42' Valencia can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

41' Hugo Duro (Valencia) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom left corner. Unai Simon guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save. The referee signals a corner kick to Valencia.
40' Ath Bilbao have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
36' Ernesto Valverde is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) suffers an injury and Inaki Williams comes on.
34' Looks like Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
32' Alejandro Rego (Ath Bilbao) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle for a foul.
30' Ath Bilbao failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
30' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Ath Bilbao comes to nothing.
27' Hugo Duro (Valencia) fails to score from the penalty spot! His effort only crashes against the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
27' Hugo Duro (Valencia) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
26' Handball by Alejandro Rego (Ath Bilbao). It's a penalty for Valencia!
26' Valencia take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
25' Luis Rioja (Valencia) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The linesman points to the corner flag, Valencia are going to take it.
23' A quickly taken corner by Valencia.
20' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
20' The resulting set piece from Ath Bilbao is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

19' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the bottom right corner that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Ath Bilbao.
17' Javi Guerra (Valencia) fires the ball from the free kick just outside the box, but he misdirects his shot high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.

15' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Aymeric Laporte (Ath Bilbao) was quite harsh and Miguel Ortiz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card. Valencia get the opportunity to endanger the opposition's goal with a free kick from the edge of the box.
14' A great run from Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) ends with a shot inside the box that flashes just past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.

12' Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
9' The Ath Bilbao players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
6' Ath Bilbao try to maintain the tempo of the game by taking a quick free kick.
5' Pepelu (Valencia) commits a rough challenge and Miguel Ortiz blows his whistle for a foul. Ath Bilbao are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
4' The corner is swung in but Ath Bilbao can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

4' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Ath Bilbao will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
